utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yeah, I’m pretty sure it’s tonight, and I still owe everyone a proper time check. I’ll make sure I don’t confuse it with the bakery run this time.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Oren—if you can confirm the time, I’d really appreciate it. I’m still catching up on the details, so the mystery novel part is all I’ve got so far.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I’m on it — I’ll check the time and let you know, and I promise not to wander into the bakery instead.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I think it’s the new mystery novel this week, but I can double-check the title if you want.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, that’d be great — I’m a bit fuzzy on the title. I’m glad book club’s still on, though.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sure — I’ll check the title and let you know. And if book club needs anything, I’ve still got the extra chairs and tea.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — send me the time once it’s set.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Will do — I’ll pass along the time as soon as it’s confirmed, and I’ve still got that spare copy if you need it.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, that helps — I’m set either way, just keep me posted on the time.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’m happy to help with the chairs. Just send me the book pick and time when you have them!

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Mara — I’ll send the book pick and time soon. And I’ve got the snacks covered.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Wonderful — thanks, Sam. I’ll look out for the book pick and time, and I’m glad the snacks are covered!

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, do we still have the book club meeting this week? And once you’ve got the time and place, let me know.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yes, we do—I’m just waiting on Vik’s update for the time and place. I’ll let you know as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks — please let me know as soon as you have the time and place.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’ll ask around and let you know as soon as I hear the title.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Tess—please let me know the title and the meeting time when you find out.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely — I’ll ask around for the title and the meeting time, and I’ll let you know as soon as I hear.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: We’re reading "The Night Circus" this month — I kept hearing people mention it at the market, so I finally picked up a copy.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Oh, nice — that’s a great pick for the club. Are we still meeting at the library next Thursday?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yes, that’s still the plan — next Thursday at the library. I’ll keep an ear out for any changes and let everyone know.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’ve got a couple in mind, so I’ll bring them to book club and we can pick together.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — bring them along and we’ll pick one at book club.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Will do — I’ll bring both options and let everyone weigh in.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks — could you let me know if it’s Thursday or Friday, and what time it starts? I can make it work after school pickup.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, I’ll check the flyer and let you know if it’s Thursday or Friday, plus the start time.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Rey — I appreciate it. Just send me the day and start time when you have it.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll check the book club details and let everyone know the plan soon.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Vik — that sounds great. Just send over the details when you have them, and I’ll help spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll check the book club details and share the plan with everyone soon.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What time should I tell everyone?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Tell everyone Thursday at 7 PM at my place, 14 Maple Street — the more, the merrier!

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thursday at 7 PM at your place, 14 Maple Street — got it. I’ll tell everyone.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, that works for me. I’ll plan to come by Thursday at 7.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Great, see you Thursday at 7. And if anyone still needs it, Gus has a spare copy of "The Midnight Library."

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, that helps — I’m set for Thursday at 7.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That’d be great, thanks. I’d like to know for sure before the next meeting.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, that helps — I’m just trying to avoid any last-minute surprises.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: No problem — I’ll check the flyer and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’ll check the flyer and make sure, but I’m pretty sure it’s The Midnight Library. If you need a copy, I’ve got an extra one to lend.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks, Gus — can you confirm the time and place too? Once you’ve checked, let me know and I’ll count myself in.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’ll check the flyer and get you the time and place right away. If it’s the one I think, you’re welcome to borrow my spare copy too.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’m still asking around, but I should have the title for you soon. Everyone’s already got opinions, of course.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: No rush at all — I’m happy to wait, and once you have the title I can help get everyone on the same page.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, that’d be great — I’ll keep poking around and tell you as soon as I hear the title.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’ll check whether it’s Thursday or Friday and confirm the start time and place.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Hana — I’ll loop everyone in once you confirm the day, time, and place.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’ll verify the day, start time, and place, then let you know as soon as I confirm them.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What time are we starting, and should I tell everyone to bring anything?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Let’s start at 7 next Thursday, and if people can bring a snack or drink to share, that’d be great.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sounds good — I’ll tell everyone 7 next Thursday and to bring a snack or drink to share.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh hey Dane — book club’s still on, right? I might’ve missed the latest details.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yep, still on — Thursday at 7 works, and we’re discussing the mystery novel. Sorry I’m late again!

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Great, thanks — I’ll stick with Thursday at 7 then. I’ve been a little out of the loop, so I appreciate the update.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Could you let me know whether it’s Thursday or Friday, and what time it starts? I can make it work if it’s after pickup.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: It’s Thursday at 7, and we’re meeting at my place on 14 Maple Street. Hope you can make it after pickup!

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thursday at 7 works for me, thanks — I’ll plan on it after pickup.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Of course — happy to help with the chairs once you send the book pick and time.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Mara — I’m still deciding between a couple of titles, so I’ll bring one to the next book club and we can choose together.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That sounds great — I’ll bring a hand with the chairs, and we can pick the book together at the next club.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thursday at 7 works for me, and I’ll bring the mystery novel. Thanks for keeping it simple.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thursday at 7 sounds perfect. Thanks, Eli — I’ll bring the snacks and see everyone at Mina’s place.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good, Sam — I’ll be there Thursday at 7 with the mystery novel.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yes, please—that’d be great. I’m always a bit behind on the details.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good—I’ll send the time once it’s set.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Leo—I appreciate it. Just let me know the time when you have it.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That sounds great, Opal — I’ll send out a few short mystery and memoir options, and we can pick the one the group likes best.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Perfect — I’ll bring a couple of clear-plot options to the library next Thursday, and we can see what the group prefers.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Wonderful — I’ll keep things simple and send the options ahead of time so everyone can take a look. Looking forward to seeing you at the library next Thursday.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh good, thanks for checking—my memory’s doing that thing again. I think it’s tonight, so let’s be ready and not wander off to the bakery first.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, tonight sounds right — I’ll double-check the mystery title and be there. And no bakery detour, promise.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Perfect, that’s a relief — I’d probably end up at the bakery if left unsupervised. See you tonight, and I’ll try to remember the book this time.

injected.text: Update: the book club has been moved from Tuesday at the library to Thursday at the cafe.
